summary: 18-year-old female backpacker became ill (vomiting, dehydration) near Jasper Lake west of Eldora; SOS via GPS device; Flight for Life flew RMRG paramedics in; group walked out with UTV assist and declined further care
location: Jasper Lake (Hessie Trail access), west of Eldora
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Nederland Fire; USFS; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Flight for Life
notes: BCSO case 23-3859; second victim is the uninjured companion (an injured dog also present)
